'''March 2000 Cedar Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 11 March 2000. [[Scott Lingrell]] won it. It is known from Michael Dalton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d340">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-12-3-11-00-cedar-grove-njd340/ 3-11-00-cedar-grove-nj], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" Dalton, 12 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-12-3-11-00-cedar-grove-njd340/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
